assessment.criterion: a held-out month is an unusual departure only when its monthly value exceeds the monthly reference q95 of the same quantity (magnitudes, one-sided) or leaves [q05, q95] (signed z); a run of at least 2 consecutive such months is sustained

behaviour_magnitude.answer: Yes - 1 of 9 held-out months lies above the monthly reference q95 of `R_B` (2024-06); the longest consecutive run is 1 month(s) (2024-06 to 2024-06), so the departure is not sustained under the pre-specified rule.
behaviour_magnitude.question: Does the held-out behaviour magnitude (R_B) exceed the monthly reference envelope?

directional_behaviour_reconfiguration.answer: Yes - directional reconfiguration is visible: z(P) lies below its monthly reference envelope in 5 of 9 held-out months (2024-01, 2024-02, 2024-05, 2024-06, 2024-07); z(gamma2) lies above it in 2024-06, 2024-08; z(gamma2) lies below it in 2024-01, 2024-02; the joint pattern z(gamma2) > 0 and z(P) < 0 holds for 4 consecutive months (2024-04 to 2024-07). This is a statement about direction, not about the size of the displacement, and it is not an anomaly verdict by itself.
directional_behaviour_reconfiguration.question: Is there directional behaviour reconfiguration in the held-out period?

environmental_coincidence.answer: The month(s) above the magnitude envelope - 2024-06 - coincide with environmental variation (2024-06: temperature_c z = +1.07, wind_speed_ms z = +0.19). This is a temporal coincidence only: no weather correction is applied and no causal attribution is made.

evidence.note: The co-variates are reported beside the OCV quantities, not inside them: no weather correction is applied and no causal attribution is made

environmental_coincidence.question: Do the pronounced held-out departures coincide with environmental variation?

geometry_magnitude.answer: No - no held-out month exceeds the monthly reference q95 of `R_G`: the highest monthly value is 0.756 against a threshold of 0.986.
geometry_magnitude.question: Does the held-out geometry magnitude (R_G) exceed the monthly reference envelope?

summer_2024.answer: Post-hoc, descriptive only: the Summer-2024 subset (22 chips, 3 monthly intervals, 2024-06-01 to 2024-08-31) has median z(gamma2) = +0.75, z(P) = -0.30, R_B = 0.836, R_G = 0.661; the remaining held-out chips (41) have +0.00, -0.27, 0.837, 0.711. The difference is not tested, no interval is attached to it, and it is not an input to the verdict.
summer_2024.question: Does the last summer before the event differ from the rest of the held-out period?

temporal_persistence.answer: `R_B`: 1 of 9 months above the q95 threshold, longest run 1 month(s) (2024-06 to 2024-06); `R_G`: 0 of 9 months above the q95 threshold, longest run 0 month(s) (no run). Persistence is decided by the fixed rule (at least 2 consecutive months), not by the shape of the curve.
temporal_persistence.question: Is any held-out departure temporally persistent?
